GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package isolates the network portion of audit finding F10 and the exfiltration threat paths. It follows the first vertical slice so a speculative universal network layer does not delay validation of the product architecture.

Alternatives.Alternative: Route every byte through one generic proxy. Rejected because engine navigation, updater, service-worker, model-provider, and feature-fetch paths have different owners and failure modes.
Treat browser navigation as a general network grant. Rejected because it would let a page-oriented feature become an arbitrary HTTP client.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The exact CEF interception mechanisms are selected from measured coverage of navigation, subresources, workers, WebSockets, downloads, and proxy behavior.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature may fetch one approved API origin, but a redirect or DNS change to a private address is denied before dispatch.
A feature may navigate a tab to an allowed origin without receiving a reusable socket or direct-fetch capability.
